cards.title: Signal diagnostics

cards.content:
### Confidence model

| Activity | Range | Strongest evidence |
|---|---:|---|
| Sleeping | 53–97 | night + master bedroom occupied |
| Watching TV | 78–96 | family room occupied |
| Working | 76–88 | office 5+ min, weekday daytime |
| Cooking | 72–90 | kitchen 5+ min, meal window |
| Listening to Music | 74–92 | music on, TV off |
| Away | 85–90 | no residents or room presence |

_Dining is not yet classified because no dining-room sensor exists._
